title: Model alias
description: The name agents use to ask for a model. It maps to one model on one backend. There is no implicit default and no automatic fallback.

name.description: The alias agents put in inference.models, e.g. qwen2.5-7b-instruct.

backend.description: The backend that serves this alias.

model.description: Model path or provider model id.

allowed_agents.description: Restrict which agents may use this alias. Recommended for hosted aliases.

fallback.description: Optional, explicit. Aliases to try, in order, if this backend is down. Empty by default. A hosted alias here means data leaves the machine.
